text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, Vodka and I are walking
through
the shopping district on our way
back from some
errands, when...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look over there. There's a crowd. I
wonder
what's goin' on?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
How about you? The stylish Umamusume
over
there! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A raffle?! This is bad, Trainer! Real bad...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My pops got hooked on the raffle and
my mom
yelled at him so much for it! She
said it's a black
hole that swallows
people's lives...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But I just can't help myself! It's in my
blood!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's okay if I just do it once, right?
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We got a free ticket for the raffle with
one of
today's purchases, so I give
Vodka a hesitant nod.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer! I'm gettin' excited!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But you've gotta keep this a secret from
my mom.
Snitches get stitches, you
know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right. Let's go! We've only got one
chance!
Let's turn the handle together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Grab the handle, shift into high gear,
and crank it
as hard as ya can. Hit the
gas and go for the
grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We muster all the strength we can, turn
the
handle, and the raffle spinner spits
out our prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! The grand-prize?! Hell
yeahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Didja see that?! We really did it! Check
us out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka looks overjoyed as if she just won
a race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh man. My heart's still poundin'. I can
feel
somethin' wellin' up inside me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Lotteries are friggin' awesome! I'll never
forget
this feeling... This thrill!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So... What did we win again?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"For two?!" Does that mean we can go
together?!
choice_data_list: They're tickets for a hot springs trip.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's great! That means there must be
an inn as
well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I bet it's in the middle of some mountain
pass. We
could stop there on a
motorcycle tour...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sweat everything out in the bath, eat
some
delicious food... It's gettin' my
blood pumpin' just
thinkin' about it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's only one problem.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a motorcycle yet. Goin' to a
hot
spring by train is just an ordinary
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm... There's gotta be some way to
enjoy it while
still bein' cool...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After giving it some thought...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we hold on to this
ticket for a
while?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I might have a motorcycle by the time
the Twinkle
Series is over, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Or do you wanna go right away?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! Thanks! Then let's save it for
later.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta go to that hot spring by
motorcycle.
Then later on, we'll have a
great story about
tackling the mountain
passes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so we put off using the ticket,
giving us one
more thing to look forward
to.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa! First-prize! That's pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A deluxe carrot hamburger steak. And it
looks
like they didn't skimp on the
ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So, how should I prepare it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I bet it'd be good cooked in red wine,
European
style...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe in a Japanese mustard sauce
to make it
spicy, yet refreshing. Or...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh. Nothing. Nothing at all! Ignore me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's only one way to eat hamburger
steak!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You gotta put it on a stick, grill it over a
bonfire,
and then eat it right off the
stick! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's do that in the academy courtyard
later. I bet
this'll give me loads of
energy. Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...The strength of the flame'll probably
be tough
to control, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka gets lost in thought about how to
cook it.
Either way, I'm just glad we won
a great prize.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Second-prize! Not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A bushel of carrots. I can have them with
meals or
as a snack between training
sessions.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But, I dunno... It's just not that cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The way I'm gonna look carryin' these
home. Me,
lugging around a big paper
bag of carrots...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll look like some homebody that just
went
shoppin'. That's not how I want
people to see me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A cool way to hold a shopping bag,
huh? ...Okay,
I got it. How 'bout like
this?
choice_data_list: Why don't you strike a cool pose with it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I can barely even hold it with both
hands. All
right, it's carrot time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gahhhhh, it's no good. Carrots are just
carrots
after all! There's no way to look
cool with 'em.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess it was a bit of a stretch. In the
end, we
decide to split the carrots
between us and carry
them home.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! A carrot! And only one! This
sucks...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess for every wild success,
there are
times when ya crash and burn.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You want this carrot, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I guess I could eat it, but I'm just not
feelin' it.
choice_data_list: No, why don't you eat it, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know. We did win it together, so
why don't
we eat it together?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sharing a meal together is a mark of
friendship,
even if it's just one carrot.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We leave together. I toss the carrot to
Vodka and
she catches it behind her
back.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aughhh! We lost! We got the worst
thing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now I get it... Things like this are totally
up to
luck. It's the same for my dad...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...True. It's more like me to finish with
nothin' than
to quit halfway.
choice_data_list: It might actually feel pretty good?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the tissues. I can use them when
I get a
nosebleed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka quietly puts the tissues in her
pocket. It
seems luck was not on her side
today.
